title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
description:
**Description**
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.
  
  
This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.
* Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.
* Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.
* Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.
* Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.
* Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**About Us**
Chips are at the center of today's tech-driven world. But how we design and verify them has not fundamentally changed in decades, while their complexity and specialization have skyrocketed due to increasing performance demands from AI. We are a dynamic, fast-moving team of software developers, ML scientists, and research-minded engineers on a mission to change that.
  
  
Operating with the agility of a startup but backed by industry-leading verification technologies, we are part of the System Verification Group (SVG). Our charter is to develop state-of-the-art EDA software and hardware platforms (including Xcelium, Jasper, Palladium, Protium, and Helium) and supercharge them with cutting-edge AI, automation, and advanced data-driven workflows.
  
  
**About This Role**
Cadence Design Systems is the leading provider of design automation tools for electronic and intelligent systems design. The ML / Software Engineer – ChipStack SuperAgent Team will be responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating AI agents that enhance productivity across the semiconductor design lifecycle. This engineer will contribute to the development of robust agent infrastructure, evaluation systems, and production-grade AI capabilities integrated within Cadence’s electronic design automation (EDA) ecosystem.
  
  
The role focuses on building reliable, scalable agentic systems that operate within complex engineering workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in ML systems and agent infrastructure, enabling deployment of high-impact AI solutions in production environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable infrastructure for AI agents operating within Cadence’s ChipStack SuperAgent ecosystem.
* Build robust evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, reliability, and alignment with engineering workflows.
* Develop data pipelines, retrieval systems, and context-engineering strategies to support consistent and grounded agent behavior.
* Contribute to continuous integration, automated testing, and observability systems to ensure production-quality deployment of AI-enabled systems.
* Optimize system performance across latency, cost, reliability, and scalability dimensions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field with 15+ Years of relevant experience in software development.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, refactoring, debugging, and testing of complex distributed systems. Demonstrated experience building production-quality systems.
* Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and practical considerations for deploying them in real-world systems (latency, cost, reliability, monitoring).
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including benchmarking, regression testing, and failure analysis.

**Skills Of Interest**

* Agent architecture: Experience with reason–act loops, planning/evaluation/self-correction patterns, tool/function calling, persistent memory systems, and structured outputs.
* LLM engineering: Familiarity with frontier LLMs and trade-offs across model families; experience with prompt engineering, context management, and alignment techniques.
* Retrieval and data systems: Understanding of RAG pipelines, embeddings, indexing strategies, chunking methodologies, and grounding techniques.
* Infrastructure and observability: Experience building logging, tracing, monitoring, and evaluation systems for ML/AI applications.
* AI-assisted development workflows: Leveraging AI tools to enhance engineering productivity and code quality.
* Interest in semiconductor design, EDA workflows, and high-performance computing environments.

**Our Culture**

* Challenge the status quo: We are innovators who challenge industry norms and push forward our vision of how silicon should be built.
* Strong opinions, loosely held: We are low on ego, but high on collaboration. We are okay to be wrong and are always open to learning.
* Ship fast, ship quality: We ruthlessly prioritize what matters. We build at lightning speed, but never compromise on the high standards required by the semiconductor industry.
* Proud of our craft: Attention to detail is in our DNA. We take pride in what we build and go the extra mile to ensure an exceptional experience for our users.

**Behavioral Skills Required**

* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrate teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Ability to establish a close working relationship with both customer peers and management.
* Explore what’s possible to get the job done, including creative use of unconventional solutions
* Work effectively across functions and geographies
* Push to raise the bar while always operating with integrity

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Singapore**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.
* Experience deploying, scaling, and debugging Large Language Model (LLM) or agent-based systems in production environments (including tools, memory, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and cost/latency profiling).
* Experience with end-to-end technical ownership of engineering projects with executive stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Experience with agentic frameworks and harness layers, such as Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) or equivalent, protocol-level interoperability (MCP, Agent-to-Agent (A2A)) across third-party Independent Software Vendor (ISV) platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), and security ecosystem in DevSecOps.
* Knowledge of LLM-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

**About The Job**
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product road map. You will embed with the engineering organizations of our largest customers and take Google's developer AI Gemini Code Assist, anti-gravity Integrated Development Environment (IDE), Software Development Kit (SDK), Command Line Interface (CLI) and the agentic surfaces beneath them from the first conversation to a production-grade workflow. You will find what actually slows an engineering organization down, design the system that fixes it, and own it end-to-end like discovery, build, roll-out, hardening, and the long tail of making it reliable.
  
  
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Design and deploy production-grade agentic developer workflows on Google Cloud's AI stack, executing large-scale refactors, language migrations, Specification-to-Pull Request pipelines, and automated review/incident-to-fix loops.
* Embed with customer's staff engineers and leaders to identify core SDLC bottlenecks, such as legacy migrations, test coverage, review latency, or onboarding friction, and define success metrics.
* Integrate Google’s agentic systems into the customer's existing ISV and tools (e.g., Teamwork Graph, GitLab, ServiceNow, Slack) leveraging MCP and A2A protocols.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

description:

Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI-powered recruiting technology, data-driven insights, and world-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
Radancy is looking for a Detection Platform Engineer to strengthen the security logging and detection capabilities supporting our global SaaS product and corporate IT environments.
  
  
Based in our Bengaluru office, you will work with infrastructure, security, and engineering teams, as well as our managed security service providers, to ensure required log sources are integrated into our SIEM, logging pipelines remain healthy, and detection rules provide effective coverage.
  
  
This role combines SIEM platform engineering, detection engineering, and log-source governance. You will also create lightweight, repeatable, and automated processes that make logging and detection requirements part of how new systems and infrastructure are deployed.
  
  
**What does a great Detection Platform Engineer do?**

* Create scalable, repeatable, and automated processes for identifying logging requirements and onboarding new infrastructure, applications, and security tools into our SIEM.
* Partner with infrastructure, security, and engineering teams to ensure required telemetry is included in new deployments and material technical changes.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot log integrations, collectors, APIs, parsers, field mappings, normalization, and ingestion pipelines.
* Monitor log-source and pipeline health, establish alerting for failures or data-quality issues, and coordinate rapid remediation when logging is interrupted or degraded.
* Create, test, tune, document, and maintain detection rules and security use cases based on Radancy’s environment, incidents, and threat intelligence.
* Review and improve detection content provided by our MSSPs, validate that expected rules are deployed and functioning, and develop additional coverage where needed.
* Maintain visibility into log-source inventory, ownership, onboarding status, retention, platform health, detection coverage, and known gaps.
* Partner with compliance and GRC teams to confirm that required security events are logged, retained, monitored, and available to support control and audit requirements.

**Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of experience in SIEM engineering, detection engineering, security platform engineering, or a related technical security role.
* Hands-on experience administering and integrating an enterprise SIEM platform.
* Experience creating, tuning, testing, and maintaining security detection rules and use cases.
* Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources from cloud, infrastructure, network, identity, endpoint, application, and security platforms.
* Working knowledge of AWS security and logging sources, including services such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs, Route 53, EKS, and EC2.
* Experience troubleshooting collectors, APIs, event streams, parsers, field mappings, normalization, and ingestion pipelines.
* Ability to translate threat intelligence, incident findings, and technical changes into logging and detection requirements.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and cross-functional communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with MSSPs or external security operations teams.
* Experience supporting logging and detection in a SaaS, cloud, or Kubernetes-based environment.
* Experience with detection-as-code, version control, scripting, APIs, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar automation tools.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection coverage mapping, and compliance or log-retention requirements.

* Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.

title: Data Architect & AI Engineering Lead, Cybersecurity - Assistant Vice President
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
The Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Assistant Vice President, will provide technical and strategic leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities. This role will drive the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI solutions that convert complex security telemetry into actionable intelligence. The AVP will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, and risk stakeholders to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making while establishing scalable engineering and data science practices across the organization
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For****
As a Data Engineer / Scientist, you will:
  
  

* Design and deliver scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, data models, and analytics-ready datasets using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud technologies.
* Build reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, data quality, reconciliation, orchestration, lineage, and observability.
* Develop statistical, machine-learning, and AI models to identify patterns, anomalies, relationships, threats, and risk signals across cybersecurity datasets.
* Apply ML, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI to improve threat detection, vulnerability prioritization, incident enrichment, cyber-risk scoring, and security posture insights.
* Develop AI solutions leveraging LLMs, embeddings, semantic/vector search, RAG, and intelligent workflows to summarize, classify, correlate, and enrich cybersecurity information.
* Operationalize data science and AI solutions through feature pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, and production workflows.
* Engineer and analyze high-volume structured, semi-structured, time-series, graph, and unstructured security data across cloud and enterprise platforms.
* Build Power BI dashboards and self-service analytical products to communicate security trends, operational performance, risk insights, and model outcomes.
* Establish strong engineering and responsible AI practices covering performance, scalability, resiliency, explainability, security, privacy, lineage, governance, and auditability.
* Partner with cybersecurity, data and platform engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to translate complex security challenges into scalable data and AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging data engineering, ML, GenAI, graph, cloud, SIEM/SOAR, and cybersecurity technologies and drive their practical adoption.

****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong technical expertise across Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI/GenAI.
* Deep understanding of Lakehouse architectures, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, orchestration, and pipeline optimization.
* Hands-on expertise with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms.
* Experience with statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, supervised and unsupervised learning, experimentation, and model evaluation.
* Practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, NLP, graph analytics, and responsible AI practices.
* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts including security telemetry, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity risk, threat intelligence, incidents, and SIEM/SOAR workflows.
* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and communicate effectively with technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Strong focus on automation, reusable engineering patterns, operational excellence, governance, and measurable business outcomes.

**Education & Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 15 to 20 years of professional experience across data engineering, data science, analytics, cloud, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines.
* Experience applying data engineering, analytics, ML, or AI techniques to cybersecurity, risk, fraud, identity, infrastructure, or other large-scale enterprise datasets.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, and large-scale data engineering.
* Experience with Lakehouse/data platform architecture, data pipelines, modeling, data quality, monitoring, lineage, and performance optimization.
* Working knowledge of AWS or comparable cloud data and analytics environments.
* Experience operationalizing analytical and ML solutions using CI/CD, version control, testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices.
* Experience with Power BI or equivalent visualization technologies.
* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or advanced coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
* Experience with Databricks/Delta Lake and Medallion architecture patterns.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or AI-assisted workflows.
* Experience developing production-grade ML/AI pipelines, model monitoring, feature pipelines, APIs, or MLOps solutions.
* Experience working with cybersecurity datasets such as endpoint telemetry, authentication events, cloud security logs, vulnerability data, asset inventories, network events, incidents, SIEM data, and threat intelligence.
* Experience in financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise environments with strong security, privacy, governance, and audit requirements.
* Relevant Security+, CySA+, GIAC, CISSP, AWS, Databricks, Data Engineering, ML/AI, or cybersecurity certifications are advantageous.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Skill Area**
****Expected Capabilities****
**Data Engineering**
Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability
  
  
**Data Science / ML**
Statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, experimentation, model evaluation and explainability.
  
  
**AI & Gen AI**
LLMs, NLP, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows.
  
  
**Cloud & DevOps**
AWS, cloud data services, CI/CD, Git, automated testing, scalable processing and MLOps.
  
  
**Cybersecurity Analytics**
SIEM/SOAR workflows, alert enrichment, cyber telemetry, vulnerability data, identity risk, incident and response datasets.
  
  
**Visualization & BI**
Power BI dashboards, operational metrics, executive-ready reporting, trend analysis, self-service analytical products.
  
  
****Additional Requirements****

* This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration expectations.
* The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.
* The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.

**Why this role is important to us**
Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. This role will bridge Data Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and AI, building trusted data foundations and intelligent solutions that improve threat detection, risk prioritization, security operations, and enterprise decision-making.

State Street is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, investment management, investment research, and trading. title: ServiceNow Developer - Officer
description:
****Role Summary & Role Description****
The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.
  
  
This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.
  
  
**Service Mapping & CMDB Management**

* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.

**Governance, BAU, Compliance & Automation**

* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.

****Core/Must Have Skills****
Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.
  
  
8-14 years hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).
  
  
Experience with tag-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.
  
  
Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).
  
  
Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).
  
  
****Good To Have Skills****

title: Staff Engineer – Hardware Engineering Strategist
description:

We are seeking a senior engineering professional with strong experience across the hardware product development lifecycle and exposure to a wide range of engineering tools and ecosystems used in the industry.

This role will evaluate engineering toolchains, assess new technologies, and drive the adoption of solutions that improve collaboration, traceability, workflow efficiency, and design reuse across engineering teams. The successful candidate will work closely with hardware, software, systems, quality, manufacturing, and IT teams to build a more connected and efficient engineering ecosystem.

* Evaluate, recommend, and drive adoption of engineering tools, technologies, and workspace capabilities that enhance collaboration, integration, and lifecycle visibility.

* Champion engineering best practices, design reuse, traceability, standardization, and scalable development methodologies across the organization.

* Lead initiatives focused on tool integration, workflow automation, digital engineering, and AI-enabled engineering solutions.

* Support the development of engineering workspaces, governance models, data management strategies, and lifecycle processes that enable a connected engineering ecosystem.

* Benchmark engineering ecosystems, tools, and industry practices to identify opportunities for modernization and continuous improvement.

* Contribute to engineering technology roadmaps and future ecosystem strategies through strong lifecycle, tooling, and industry knowledge.

* Drive successful solution adoption through stakeholder engagement, training, documentation, user workshops, and engineering advocacy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering

* 10+ years of experience in engineering organizations with strong exposure to the complete hardware product development lifecycle.

* Hands-on experience working with industry-standard engineering tools and platforms such as Altium, Altium 365 (A365), Cadence, Siemens Xpedition, Ansys, MATLAB/Simulink, Teamcenter, Windchill, Jira, Git, and related engineering collaboration solutions.

* Strong knowledge of engineering data management, configuration management, change control, traceability, design reuse, and lifecycle governance practices.

* Understanding of engineering tool integrations, workflow automation, digital thread, digital engineering, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills with the ability to drive organizational change and solution adoption.

* Ability to lead workshops, training sessions, process improvement initiatives, and cross-functional transformation programs.

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and
**shape the future**
with us?

title: Senior SAP FICO Specialist
description:
**Job Title: SAP FICO In-House Specialist**
Location: Chennai, India
  
  
Company: Glencore
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About Us:**
Glencore is one of the world’s largest globally diversified natural resource companies. Our operations encompass the production, sourcing, processing, and marketing of various commodities. We are committed to sustainable practices and strive to create value for our stakeholders.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
We are looking for a skilled SAP FICO In-House Specialist to join our IT team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules. This role will involve ensuring the integrity of financial data and optimizing financial processes across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and support SAP FICO solutions to meet business requirements and enhance financial reporting.
* Manage and optimize complex solutions that are both standard and bespoke, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective SAP solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to financial data and system interfaces.
* Conduct data analysis and prepare financial reports to support management decision-making.
* Stay updated on SAP FICO best practices, new functionalities, and regulatory changes to ensure compliance.
* Provide training and support to end-users and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in SAP FICO implementation and support, with a focus on complex interfaces.
* Strong understanding of financial processes and reporting requirements.
* Experience with integration tools and technologies (e.g., IDoc, BAPIs, RFC) is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
* The chance to make a significant impact in a leading global company.

**Who We Are**
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
  
  
With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
  
  
Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
  
  
Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
  
  
We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.

Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

: Senior Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Digital Risk - Mumbai

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
  
  
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Job Description – AI Risk and Governance – Technical - Senior Consultant Key Responsibilities:
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks across Responsible AI dimensions, including bias, fairness, robustness, explainability, privacy, and model/data security.
* Perform quantitative AI model testing using internal testing toolkits and external evaluation platforms.
* Conduct AI red teaming assessments (manual and automated) to identify safety, security, misuse, and adversarial risks.
* Design and implement Responsible AI frameworks for bias detection, fairness evaluation, explainability, and robustness.
* Build and maintain automated AI validation, monitoring, and alerting pipelines across development and production environments.
* Implement model interpretability and explainability solutions to support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and stakeholder trust.
* Define and operationalize RAI metrics, dashboards, and monitoring systems for ongoing compliance and risk tracking.
* Design and operationalize AI governance processes for model lifecycle management, approvals, and change control.
* Configure, deploy, and monitor AI systems in cloud and on premise environments using MLOps, LLMOps, and DevOps practices.
* Partner with cybersecurity, fraud, and information security teams to address AI driven security, scam, and abuse risks.
* Translate AI regulations, laws, and ethical standards into technical requirements, controls, and engineering guardrails.
* Communicate AI risks, controls, and business impact clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Develop technical documentation, standards, and training materials to support organization wide Responsible AI adoption. Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* 4–7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, data science, AI risk, or AI governance roles.
* Hands on experience building, testing, deploying, and monitoring AI/ML systems in production.
* Strong understanding of Responsible AI risks, including bias, fairness, robustness, explainability, privacy, and security.
* Experience with quantitative AI testing, validation frameworks, and evaluation platforms.
* Working knowledge of MLOps / LLMOps / DevOps and CI/CD workflows for ML systems.
* Ability to translate regulatory and governance requirements into actionable technical controls.
* Strong communication skills, including experience working with cross functional or client facing teams.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, or safety assessments.
* Experience collaborating with cybersecurity, fraud, or enterprise risk teams.
* Familiarity with agentic AI systems (e.g., autonomous agents, tool use, multi step reasoning) and associated risks.
* Preferred Certifications o Azure AI Engineer Associate/AWS Machine Learning – Specialty/Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer o CISSP/CCSP/CRISC

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Master of Computer Applications
* Master of Business Administration
* Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

**Experience**

* Artificial Intelligence (3+ years)

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
